content.short: Exolix is an instant crypto exchange offering registration-free swaps between assets.
content.description: Exolix runs registration-free swaps between a wide list of assets, quoting a rate and settling to the destination wallet without holding customer accounts. The category competes almost entirely on rate and supported-asset coverage, since the user experience is near-identical from one provider to the next.
content.meta: Exolix is an instant crypto exchange offering registration-free swaps between digital assets.
